Assistant Professor Shun-Nan Chiang interacts with students during class. (Photo Credit:ICI)

Assistant Professor Shun-Nan Chiang interacts with students during class. (Photo Credit:ICI)

Assistant Professor Shun-Nan Chiang interacts with students during class. (Photo Credit:ICI)

Assistant Professor Shun-Nan Chiang interacts with students during class. (Photo Credit:ICI)

Assistant Professor Shun-Nan Chiang of the International College of Innovation at National Chengchi University is offering the course "Innovation and Global Development" in the 113-1 academic term. This course aims to guide students in exploring the relationship between major global challenges and innovative solutions. It covers various forms of innovation and encourages students to apply critical analytical frameworks to examine the limitations and issues of current innovation-driven solutions.

In his recent article, "Solutions and Dissatisfaction in the Wave of Sustainable Development," published in the Dong Hwa Journal of Humanities and Social Sciences, Professor Chiang delves into innovation competitions and solutions to social problems, echoing the themes of his course. He notes that in recent years, innovation-centric competitions have emerged worldwide, aiming to address major social issues such as poverty, hunger, and climate change through technology and business models. However, these competitions often overlook other potentially more suitable solutions. Overreliance on technological innovation can lead to an oversimplification of the problem's essence and even neglect structural social challenges.

Additionally, Professor Chiang points out that this competition-driven model of solution production often aligns with Silicon Valley's startup ecosystem, emphasizing speed, innovation, and market orientation, but potentially neglecting long-term social impacts and equity. He advocates for a more comprehensive and diverse perspective when addressing major global challenges, combining frugal innovation, community-oriented solutions, and policy innovation labs to effectively solve problems.

Through the "Innovation and Global Development" course, Professor Chiang hopes to cultivate students' critical thinking, deepen their understanding of the complex relationship between innovation and global development, and encourage them to explore diverse and comprehensive solutions to current societal challenges. His research and course content offer a reflective perspective on the current enthusiasm for innovation, reminding us to carefully assess the appropriateness and long-term impacts of solutions while pursuing innovation.

Dear ICI Students,

Are you planning to participate in an exchange program at one of ICI’s partner colleges? We sincerely invite you to join this online information session to gain a comprehensive understanding of the exchange program. This session will feature alumni who have participated in exchange programs, sharing their valuable experiences and offering practical advice to address any concerns you may have before studying abroad. Additionally, we will provide a detailed explanation of the key application procedures to help you prepare effectively.

Date: Monday, 13 January 2025

Time: 14:00 (Taiwan Time)

Sign-up Link: [https://forms.gle/Af7ZdGChKUNji8eY6](https://forms.gle/Af7ZdGChKUNji8eY6)

Date 2025-01-21

[2025 ICI Admissions: Your Global Learning Journey Begins Here](https://ici.nccu.edu.tw/upload/91/doc/38140/2025-ICI-Admissions.jpg)

The International College of Innovation (ICI) at National Chengchi University is pleased to announce the opening of the 2025 2nd Phase Admissions.

♦ Application Period: February 13, 2025 – March 20, 2025

The Bachelor of Arts in Global Studies (BA in Global Studies) program offers an interdisciplinary education that equips students with the skills and knowledge to address global challenges, preparing them for successful careers in an increasingly interconnected world.

Why Choose ICI?

 

The International College of Innovation provides a fully English-taught curriculum and interdisciplinary programs, offering students a comprehensive and internationalized education experience.

1. All-English Curriculum

Courses include global studies, Asian studies, data sciences, and international law, designed to integrate theory and practice for comprehensive skill development.

2. International Academic and Professional Opportunities

Students become part of a global academic community composed of international faculty and peers, with access to overseas exchanges, international internships, and collaborative projects.

3. Free Chinese Language Classes

Chinese language courses are provided to help students enhance their language skills while gaining a deeper understanding of local culture, boosting their international competitiveness.

4. Scholarship Support

A wide range of scholarships is available for eligible students to reduce financial barriers and enable them to focus on academic and professional growth.

Application Information

 

How to Apply

For detailed application information, please visit the NCCU Admissions Portal: [https://nccuadmission.nccu.edu.tw/?lang=en](https://nccuadmission.nccu.edu.tw/?lang=en)

Learn More About ICI

Discover more about ICI’s programs and resources on the official website: [https://ici.nccu.edu.tw/](https://ici.nccu.edu.tw/)

The International College of Innovation is dedicated to fostering leaders with global perspectives and innovative capabilities. We warmly invite you to join our academic community and embark on a path toward excellence.

[ICI “Overseas Exchange and International Competition Participation Scholarship” – Applications Now Open](https://ici.nccu.edu.tw/upload/91/doc/38129/出國交換.jpg)

ICI “Overseas Exchange and International Competition Participation Scholarship”

– Applications Now Open

The International College of Innovation (ICI) is pleased to announce that applications for the Overseas Exchange and International Competition Participation Scholarship are now open. ICI undergraduate students who participated in an overseas exchange program or international competition abroad during the 2024 Fall or 2025 Spring Semester (Academic Year 113) are welcome to apply.

Objective

	This scholarship aims to encourage ICI undergraduate students to engage in overseas learning experiences—such as exchange programs or international competitions—to broaden their global perspective, enhance international mobility, and strengthen future competitiveness.

Eligibility

	Applicants must meet the following criteria:

	(a) Be currently enrolled ICI undergraduate students officially registered for the semester during which the overseas activity took place (students on leave are not eligible).

	(b) ICI undergraduate students who have participated in:

An outbound exchange program (through ICI or other NCCU departments), or

An international competition abroad during the 2024–2025 academic year.

Scholarship Amount and Quota

	(a) The number of recipients and the amount awarded may be adjusted based on the number of applicants and the annual budget.

	(b) The maximum scholarship amount is as follows:

 Asia-Pacific Region: NT$20,000

 Europe and the Americas: NT$40,000

Priority Criteria

	(a) Priority will be given to students participating in the ICI college-level overseas exchange program. Additional points will be awarded to applicants who have taken the BEST Test of English Proficiency (BESTEP).

	(b) Priority ranking according to participated activities is as follows

 Participation in exchange programs at ICI’s partner institutions.

Participation in international competitions abroad.

 Participation in exchange programs through other NCCU departments or offices.

Required Documents

	Applicants must email the following to Ms. Florence Tan (ttsflo@g.nccu.edu.tw):

	(a) Completed Application and Eligibility Confirmation Form

	(b) A 1,000-word reflection or learning report in English

	(c) Transcript from the host institution (for exchange students)

	(d) Proof of competition participation and results (for competition participants)

	(e) Full transcript of NCCU academic records

	(f) NCCU ranking certificate

	(g) BESTEP score report (for bonus points) or other English proficiency test results (if available)

	(h) E-Ticket (with Booking Number/Reservation No.)

	(i) Copies of both departure and return boarding passes (original boarding passes must be submitted to the ICI Office within one week of the new semester)

Application Regulations

	(a) Each student is eligible to receive this scholarship only once per degree level. Priority is given to those joining ICI college-level exchange program. Students who have already received government or NCCU funding for similar purposes are not eligible for duplicate scholarships.

	(b) Scholarships will be disbursed only after all required documents are submitted and reviewed.

	(c) Recipients must consent to the public sharing of their reflection or learning reports and agree to participate in future ICI sharing sessions or events related to international exchange.

Application deadline: Friday, August 15 at 15:00.

Please email your application documents Ms. Florence Tan ([ttsflo@g.nccu.edu.tw](mailto:ttsflo@g.nccu.edu.tw)) with the subject title: Overseas Exchange and International Competition Participation Scholarship Application

[ICI Dean Wen-Ling Tu Appointed Director of the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Office for Radioactive Waste Disposal, Leading Legislative Efforts on High-Level Radioactive Waste Management](https://ici.nccu.edu.tw/upload/91/doc/38148/英文-4.jpg)

At a critical juncture in Taiwan’s energy transition and pursuit of environmental sustainability, Professor Wen-Ling Tu, Dean of the International College of Innovation (ICI) at National Chengchi University, has been appointed by the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) as Director of the newly established Office for Radioactive Waste Disposal. In this new role, she will lead efforts to establish and formalize the legal framework for Taiwan’s high-level radioactive waste management policies.

Her appointment not only demonstrates the government’s commitment to transparent public engagement on nuclear waste issues but also highlights the expertise of ICI faculty in the fields of sustainable governance and public policy.

The office’s primary objective is to advance legislation on the “High-Level Radioactive Waste Site Selection Act,” aiming to establish a sound legal framework, address societal concerns, and ensure that decision-making processes are grounded in democratic legitimacy.

Dean Tu brings a wealth of interdisciplinary academic expertise and practical experience, with a longstanding focus on environmental policy, science and technology studies, civic engagement, and sustainable development. In recent years, she has led several policy planning and public participation projects related to nuclear waste management, including the “Preliminary Civic Dialogue Planning for Nuclear Waste Issues,” the “Nuclear Waste Social Communication Planning Project,” and the “Site Selection Social Communication Project for Nuclear Waste Facilities” commissioned by Taiwan Power Company, as well as the “High-Level Radioactive Waste Final Disposal Legal Framework and Public Engagement Project” commissioned by the Energy Administration. Her contributions have played a vital role in shaping open and inclusive policy dialogue on this complex issue.

Since its founding, the International College of Innovation (ICI) has made interdisciplinary learning and social engagement its core values, striving to bridge academic knowledge with real-world policy challenges. Dean Tu’s appointment as Director of the Office for Radioactive Waste Disposal reflects the college’s mission to promote knowledge democratization and fulfill the university’s social responsibility.

Looking ahead, ICI will continue to support its faculty in engaging with public affairs, encouraging the integration of academic research and policy practice, and deepening contributions to society. The college remains committed to cultivating a new generation of leaders equipped with global vision and a strong sense of civic responsibility for Taiwan and beyond.
